name: live-sessions
title: Live sessions: the iPhone side
summary: A live session is a stretch of time spent on one thing outside the app. It starts in two taps from the Library's plus, from a Lock Screen control, from Siri or from the Watch, and it is running at once: the position question is a field on the running screen, never a gate. While it runs it is a pinned Live row at the top of the Library and the first group on the Margins tab, and a Live Activity with Record, Mark and End. Ending a meeting is one tap and makes it a Library item at once; an audiobook's end asks one question, where you stopped. Line up is on the item's screen and on any transcript file opened in the app, so it works the next day. A Margin taken with no session running starts a quick session, so nothing waits in a hidden inbox.
shared_fixes: A Margin is filed by its own clock time into the session whose span holds it. A Margin outside every span goes into a quick session for that time, never into 'the most recent session'.
The Watch and the Lock Screen are told when a Margin is filed, and say 'Filed in <session>' only then. Before that they say 'Saved on Watch, waiting for iPhone'.
The spoken placing hint is shown while a spoken Margin records, on every surface that records: the session screen, the Live Activity, the Watch.

A session's position answers are checkpoints: a clock time paired with the source position the listener gave. Start and end are just the first and last checkpoint, so a wrong start can be fixed afterwards and every estimate recomputes.

screens.title: Library
screens.note: Gains a pinned Live row at the top while a session runs: kind, name, running clock, Margin count. Finished sessions are ordinary rows, labelled Session with their kind, and 'Not lined up' in words while a meeting has no transcript.

screens.title: Add Source (choose a type, or Paste)
screens.note: Gains a 'Take Margins on something else' row of four buttons: Meeting, Audiobook, Paper book, Something else. Each one starts a session at once. While a session runs, the row says so and offers Go to it, or End it and start a new one.

screens.title: Margins
screens.note: A running session is the first group, headed Live. A quick session is a group like any other, named by its day and time, with Rename and Move to another session on its heading.

screens.title: Item details
screens.note: For a session item: when it ran, its checkpoints (editable), where each Margin came from (phone, Watch, Lock Screen, Siri), Line up with a transcript or recording, and Share as Markdown.

screens.title: Live session
screens.note: The running session. Top: name (editable), clock, and 'Where are you now?' with the kind's default filled in (0:00 for a meeting). Then Speak, Write and Mark, the Margins so far with where each came from, and End. When the phone's microphone is busy, Speak says why and points to the Watch or to Write.

screens.title: End session: where did you stop?
screens.note: Only for an audiobook or a paper book. One field, filled with the app's estimate, and End. Skip ends without it.

screens.title: Lined up
screens.note: Shown after a transcript or recording is picked. The line-up is already applied, with Undo. Each Margin shows its position and all of its evidence: the estimate, the listener's own setting, the transcript match and how sure it is. The session it was lined up with is named at the top, with Change.

screens.title: The other app (Teams, Zoom, Audible, YouTube...)
Live Activity (Lock Screen and Dynamic Island)
screens.note: Clock, Margin count, last filed Margin. Buttons: Record (Stop while recording), Mark, End. Record is hidden when the phone's microphone is known to be busy.
